notes.title: MILFs of Sunville: Season 2 - completed has been released!
notes.content:
[p]Hi, everyone![/p][p align="start"]We are happy to present the final update for the second season of your favorite game, [b]MILFs of Sunville![/b][/p][p align="start"]Right now, we are at a very important stage in the long journey we have taken together with you.
Your trust and support have enabled us to complete the second season of our ambitious project.[/p][p align="start"]We have been developing it for 3 years and have put all our inspiration, creativity, and love into it, striving to increase the quality of the project with every new update, make it memorable, and find new passion to achieve new heights every time![/p][p align="start"]The second season of MILFs of Sunville [b]ends with an impressive update[/b]. This is [b]the largest update[/b] in the history of the game.
The total volume of new content in this update [b]is about 3.5 GB (!) and over than 5000 images with tons of animations![/b][/p][p align="start"]Our team worked hard and gave it their all, striving to ensure that you get the best possible experience.[/p][p align="start"]In this update, just like in Breeze of Passion, we used motion capture technology. Now you can enjoy a more lifelike version of the characters you love so much. You can also [b]enjoy the dances[/b] of some of them ([b]including Sophie![/b]).[/p][p align="start"]This update is packed with scenes and animations, but not all of them can be experienced in a single playthrough.
Many moments depend on the choices you make. If you didn’t get what you were hoping for, try a different route on your next run – you may discover much more![/p][p align="start"]Our team was so dedicated to the development of this update that Lakshmi, a member of our L7team, even recorded vocals for the game’s ending.[/p][p align="start"]However, we will not be saying goodbye to your favorite characters.
[b]We plan to release several DLCs for MILFs of Sunville.[/b]
There will be Extra content DLC (very soon), a story DLC, a DLC dedicated to Cynthia, and a DLC dedicated to Sophie.[/p][p align="start"]We also plan to start a new project in the same genre as MILFs of Sunville involving Blender software, which will allow us to significantly improve the visuals and unlock the true potential of spicy animations.[/p][p align="start"]All this time, you have been with us, inspiring us with your support, your warm feedback, and your constructive criticism, which has helped us become better![/p][p align="start"][b]We thank each and every one of you for your contribution to the development of this project![/b][/p][p align="start"][b]With much love,
L7team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/b5adf49ff3ad5f03aa09f348c6b32bca416cd9ea.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The sixth progress report MILFs of Sunville: Season 2v10
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/6eda54dbdb42ded98426f5324695246c6834c817.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]🎉 Dear MILF lovers![/b][/p][p]We’re happy to announce that the release has already gone[url="https://www.patreon.com/posts/milfs-of-season-137079006"] [b][i]live on Patreon[/i][/b][/url], and as usual, we’ve sent the build to Steam moderators for review. 🚀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/bb30912d56378ac2ab883903dc40cd900cc08252.jpg"][/img][/p][p]However, right after the launch, some players encountered an issue with the quest involving the road and the beloved Sophie. We’ve partially fixed the bug, but for a few players it still remains. We want to be open with you about this: the time gap between releases on different platforms is due to exactly this. When you receive the game on Steam, it no longer contains most of the errors that might have slipped into the early build. This means the Steam version is much more stable and “polished.” ✨[/p][p][/p][p]We truly value you, your support, and your patience, and once again, we want to thank you for staying with us. 💖[/p][p][/p][p]📅 We plan to release [b][i]on Steam by the end of this week[/i][/b]. Please bear with us just a little longer — we assure you, it’ll be worth the wait![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/fa0f4404b662bcfc7fec41847afa854adf73f79d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In this post, we’ll also include some spoilers we haven’t shared here before. We hope they’ll make you happy and brighten up your wait.[/p]

notes.title: The fifth progress report MILFs of Sunville: Season 2v10
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/a2703c9e3f908853fcf1f946cc1a60d2d027ac28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We hope you’re enjoying your weekend, while we’re busy putting the finishing touches on the upcoming release, which is almost ready. It will feature over [b]5000(!!!) new images[/b] — as much as you’d get if we released Episodes 1 through 4 of Milf’s of Sunville Season 2 all at once.[/p][p]On top of that, we’ve enhanced our animations by implementing motion capture technology. This has given us an enormous number of high-quality animations, the creation of which, in terms of scale and resource investment, is comparable to producing another full update. Very soon, you’ll be able to enjoy this massive and content-packed release.[/p][p]In the meantime, the incomparable Daisy will keep you company to make the wait a little more pleasant.[/p]

Staying true to tradition, we're kicking things off with fresh new spoilers as we count down to the upcoming release — it’s getting closer every day, and you won’t have to wait too long.

notes.title: The third progress report MILFs of Sunville: Season 2v10
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/6488fff454e482e950c749493a9fcabf432a94fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Let’s start with some good news. In this post, we’re sharing the very first teaser from the upcoming [i]Milfs of Sunville[/i] release — an [i][u]artwork featuring the stunning Miss Brooks.[/u][/i][/p][p]Many of you have been asking which characters will be getting new content in the next update. We began touching on this topic in the last dev report, but that was just the tip of the iceberg. Today, it’s time to reveal a bit more.[/p][p]This is the final release, and we want the main story arcs to reach a satisfying conclusion — or at least a solid checkpoint. Some plotlines will continue in future DLCs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/094f37af90eb9933ea71f1c28c7bab3872effdb0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Now let’s get into the details. Starting with [b][i]Miss Richardson[/i][/b]. Dominant, strict, and impossibly hot. We know how much you love her — and for good reason. This time, trouble will catch the MC off guard, and, as always, the ever-watchful principal won’t miss a thing. You’ll have to figure out how to get out of it. One of the tried-and-true methods? A little leverage. We all know what this iron lady is really missing — affection. And you’ll have the perfect chance to give it to her… in every possible position. Expect plenty of scenes with Miss Richardson — not just in her office. And if you make the right choices, you might even unlock something extra spicy: provocative photos included.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/5945904e160985fbb801720e1d69d26d9a26543a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Richardson doesn’t just keep students in check — she’s hard on the faculty, too. And in this update, [b][i]Miss Clark[/i][/b] takes the hit. A test that feels like a death sentence, and even private lessons might not be enough to save you. But what if failure leads to opportunity? It’s all about how you handle the situation. Play your cards right, and you’ll earn a sizzling scene with one of the most seductive teachers in the college.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/46dd0ab54e3773852fc80c270f58137e3a89f6d2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]That’s all the spoilers for today. But don’t forget — the students also have some sweet surprises in store. You’ll find out what they’ve been up to very soon.[/p][p]The release is already in its final stages. Thank you for sticking with us — your support keeps the whole team moving forward. More teasers are on the way… and after that, the full release.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The second progress report MILFs of Sunville: Season 2v10
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/d17ab9bf123df65352ddfbe7c194876aae5a2b81.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, dear players![/p][p]First of all, we want to [i][u]thank you for your patience and support.[/u][/i] We know how long you've been waiting for news, and we're excited to share our progress: we’ve officially started localizing the final update of [b][i]MILFs of Sunville[/i][/b] into all available in-game languages. It’s a complex and time-consuming process — the amount of text and visual content in this update is truly massive. But together with our amazing translators, we’re working at an accelerated pace to bring you the results as soon as possible.[/p][p]Now, let’s move on to the most exciting part — a little teaser of the content and scenes you can expect in the upcoming update.[/p][p]The most common question — will Sophia be there? Of course she will! In fact, you're in for one of the biggest scenes of the entire update featuring her — and Daisy. These two stunning MILFs will engage in a “battle of preferences” as they test out some accessories from Daisy’s shop right before your eyes. At the climax, you’ll have to pick your favorite — and this choice, along with others during the scene, will determine which of these two seductresses you’ll enjoy one of the steamiest scenes of the release with.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/08df72f23c4f6a9f967e40d6598e60f49fecfcd7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]College events haven’t been overlooked either. Your creative talents once again catch the attention of the faculty — and this time, they’ve decided to challenge you in a new way. You’ll need to step up not just as an artist, but as an actor too. That’s right — this time, you’ll be taking part in a theatrical performance. Miss Morris and Miss Wilson will be your stage partners, and let’s just say that modesty won’t be making an appearance backstage...[/p][p]Also, by popular demand, this update will finally bring you a full-length, intense scene with trainer Brooks. We know many of you have been waiting a long time for this — and we didn’t hold back. However, earning this scene won’t be easy. You’ll need to be smart, attentive, and patient. Every choice matters. Only those who really put in the effort will unlock the most desired reward. And trust us — it’s worth it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/ca9c0c561bdb4008eae4246c6115e4599d5b4177.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And that’s not all. In our next dev report, we’ll reveal which other beauties will be featured in the update — so stay tuned.[/p][p]For now — thank you again for your patience and support. Very soon, we’ll begin sharing visual teasers. Trust us, this update will be worth every minute of waiting.[/p]

notes.title: First progress report MILFs of Sunville: Season 2v10
notes.content:
[b]Hello, our beloved MILFs of Sunville players! 💖[/b]

It’s already been a month and a half since the release of the highly anticipated 2v9 update — one of the biggest updates in the history of the project.[u][i] We’ve received so many kind words and heartfelt support from you, and we just want to say — we truly appreciate it.[/i][/u] 🙏💌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/a8055776e5ae63862fa1ca855de7a085a79a11dd.jpg[/img]

As we've mentioned many times before, the project will have only two seasons, and right now, our entire team is focused on preparing the final release of MILFs of Sunville — version 2v10. This will be the conclusion of the whole story, and we want it to be rich, vibrant, and memorable. 🌟📖

After the release of 2v9, we needed a few weeks to fully focus on wrapping up the DLC for our other project, Breeze of Passion, which was announced after the main game concluded last year. The development of this DLC has been ongoing for several months. 🛠️ Throughout this time, we’ve constantly switched between working on MILFs of Sunville and Breeze of Passion to keep both moving forward.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2409780/Breeze_of_Passion/

[b]The DLC is massive [/b]— not just an add-on, but a full event with a beginning, climax, and ending. It features brand-new stunning MILFs 💃 alongside the beloved heroines from the main game 😍. [b]We’ve poured our hearts into it ❤️.[/b]

Our wonderful artists have been working non-stop 🎨✨. As soon as they completed the art and animations for 2v9, they immediately switched to the final polishing of the Breeze of Passion DLC. Now that the DLC is fully wrapped up 🎁, they’ve completely dived back into the final release of 2v10 for MILFs of Sunville. This last release is a personal challenge for us 💪, and we want you to be as proud of the result as we are 🥹.

We want to be honest with you — to finish MILFs of Sunville at the level this story deserves, we’ll need a bit more time than usual ⏳.[u] As you might remember, 2v9 was essentially the size of two full releases.[/u]

We’ve also improved our animation system — now the characters move more realistically and fluidly than ever before 🎥💫. That’s thanks to our use of a real motion model, whose movements are recorded and adapted for the characters. It’s a complex but crucial part of our work, and we want to make sure it’s done right, to give you the best experience and enjoyment possible 🌈🎮.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481366/3b576de33f7b4a0715114197c30dd8387ab31438.jpg[/img]

We sincerely hope for the understanding and support of our warm, caring community 🫶. You’ve been with us for so long, and every comment 💬, every moment of anticipation before a release — it’s an incredible motivation and the greatest reward for us 🥰.

And of course, after MILFs of Sunville is complete, we’ll begin working on DLC for this very project as well 🧑‍💻. We’re not saying goodbye — we’re just getting started 🚀.

Please don’t worry — we’ll continue sharing news, spoilers, art, and development updates for MILFs of Sunville 2v10, so you’ll always be in the loop and feel our love and care 📰❤️.

[b]Thank you for your patience, your support, and most of all — your love 💕. It’s because of you that all of this is possible.[/b]

See you soon — there’s so much more to come! 🌟🔥

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[b]🎉 Dear friends! 🎉[/b]

The New Year is just around the corner, and we at L7team want to wish each and every one of you a [b]Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! 🎄[/b] May this holiday season bring warmth, joy, and unforgettable moments with your loved ones. Here’s to happiness, health, success, and making all your dreams come true in 2025!

This year has been nothing short of incredible for us. We’ve worked tirelessly to bring you new stories and exciting improvements. Over the past year, we released four major updates for Breeze of Passion, with the final update being so massive it could easily count as two full updates combined!

On top of that, we delivered four major updates for MILFs of Sunville: Season 2, packed with gameplay enhancements. This year, we introduced the Love Bar system, where each girl has her own unique rhythm, and we significantly improved the quality of animations.
